sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.ClassNumber AS quoteNumber, s.OrderStateName AS status, o.OrderDate AS quoteDate, ad.ExpirationDate AS expirationDate, o.Total AS total FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState s ON s.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail ad ON ad.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE oc.ClassCode = @quoteClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) AND (@status IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@status)) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY o.ClassNumber
